Ghost sailors from the lost expedition. They do not bleed, so no predator hunts them by scent; only the Ghost Worm and the Cave Caiman attack them (cold things). They never use slipstreams and walk the dry chambers as easily as they swim.
Advances in a line; never retreats
Its lantern-less face glows faintly 1 s before it swings
Walks ahead of the squad; its light draws luminous-curious beasts (firefly squid, anglerfish) onto whoever stands near it; 30 nerves
The lantern flares before beasts arrive
Hooks a diver and drags them toward the Deckhands
Rings: every beast in 30 m investigates the ringer's target (it points at a diver); 8 noise
Commands from the rear; Deckhands within 10 m ignore stun and slow
His lantern turns green before an order

1. A squad enters at the Lantern Cache in the Cricket Cavern and walks Cavern -> Toad Pool -> Roost, then swims down the Chimney to the Gallery; it never enters a slipstream and never crawls the Squeeze.
2. On contact: the Lantern Bearer stands still (a lure), the Rope Hand hooks the nearest diver, the Deckhands close in a line, the Bell Ringer rings at the diver who is reviving or reloading.
3. They ignore beasts entirely; beasts ignore them except the Ghost Worm and the caiman. A squad walked past the Ghost Worm's wall loses two Deckhands.
4. They cannot be lured by chum or blinded by ink; flares confuse them (they walk toward flares). Nets hold them 4 s. Melee kills them fastest (axes are silent and they are slow).
5. In a Hunt the Bosun waits in the Roost; the squads try to drive the divers up into the dry chambers where they walk faster than divers.
Spotting: 'Living ones. Fetch the lanterns.' / 'Down here we're all crew.'
Bell: 'Ring them in.' / 'The bell calls what's hungry.'
Ghost Worm attacks them: 'It knows us. Back, back!'
A Deckhand falls: 'He'll be back at the cache.' / 'Ninety days out and no relief.'
Bosun: 'Every hand to the light. Bring them below.' / 'The captain wants a full muster.'
Enemy HP x1.08 per tide; weapons upgrade every 5 tides (Forged at 15+).
